description: This file declares exported functions for the Web Roof State Machine (RooFsm) component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: WebCreateRooFsm
methods.description: Creates a new Web RooFsm object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: WebRooFsmCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Web RooFsm object.

methods.name: WebRooFsmRemove
methods.description: Removes an existing Web RooFsm object.

methods.name: WebRooFsmEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Web RooFsm instance.
